rounds.notes:
This round is simple, you buy [Primal Punch](item_3b024d32-8fa1-4713-80ee-e042867f5228) which is the foundation of our build. I like to go with [Siphon Gloves](item_099f8177-c2a4-4e13-b321-99349f8b1eb7) and [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) to add to that melee dmg while also giving you some small healing while you melee. 

I'd say important part of this round is getting a feel for the other team, how they play, how bunched up they are, which enemies peel, which enemies have abilities to disrupt what you want to do etc. Find their weaknesses as well as potential enemies that you might have a hard time dealing with.

These allow us to be a lot tankier while dealing a lot more damage ( [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) gives us 100 armor and also 20% melee dmg boost because of [Primal Punch](item_3b024d32-8fa1-4713-80ee-e042867f5228)).

rounds.notes:
Buy [Lunar Leap](item_dd41728d-7997-487f-93f5-859b3e9d0c84) to build ult fast and get some sustain when you jump. 

If they have a lot of poke or damage over time stuff like burn from [Ashe](hero_37b42a2d-a82d-4a22-9df2-4c812c873b54) and [Junkrat](hero_3ac20f6c-2bce-45f3-998e-9129cc6e5c05) or wound from [Junker Queen](hero_4794d288-27d9-49e0-a1dd-ffe0f4de3ab1), buy [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d) for another 10% melee dmg boost while increasing your survivability to consistent damage

If they have a lot of burst or a [Reaper](hero_0449752f-1c58-487b-b9a0-ca727d784457) and you cant survive when you dive in, buy [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4) for still added melee dmg but more so sruvivability against burst damage

rounds.notes:
Now we add [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) pretty much everytime unless you literally cannot survive then go [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4). 
[Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) gives you 25% melee dmg with the armor bonus plus more sustain with healing, here is where you start to shift into a more aggressive playstyle. You have the chunky health to survive, now its time to start playing way more aggressive.

rounds.notes:
Now we buy [Tesla Field](item_68f73d99-6d07-40f5-ad28-0c69f45487c7) to add to the oppressiveness of our dives. This coupled with [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) makes it so right when you dive someone, your bubble or your slam (if bubble's on cooldown but you still wanna dive someone) applies antiheal instantly so it makes it way easier for you to finish them off. 

If you didnt buy [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) last round I would recommend selling [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4) or [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d) (whichever you need less depending on enemy dmg output) to buy [Gloomgauntlet](item_76cb8fe3-3c1f-4769-a1ec-a9c2dc510ba7) as well as [Cybervenom](item_210a8582-91ec-4cf3-968a-a443f3a0c505) because these are so important for your lethality and worth sacrificing some survivability for.

rounds.notes:
This round is pretty simple:

Get [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b) if you can survive well and want to increase your lethality.

OR

Get [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4) or [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d) (whichever you dont have) if you want more tankiness.

At this point in the game, both are good options, just depends on what you need, but your build should have good enough tankiness and dmg output so buff whatever you like more.

An ok third option is [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98) if they are hard to pin down or they have a lucio but its a very niche situation and I recommend the other abilities more.

rounds.notes:
Get [Circuit Breaker](item_ee0bd3b8-4c0d-40e6-a2a2-be20deef0e19) to give you more sustain and damage from your bubble.

For your last purple, buy either [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b), [Rustung Von Wilhelm](item_aea17a63-3f55-4f91-8f49-a7793fbc56c4), or [Ogundimu Reduction Field](item_b12daf48-069b-44c1-88fe-221cbcff664d) to complete the trifecta of having all these abilities because they are all useful. 

If you notice the enemy team is a little slippery you can buy [Liquid Nitrogen](item_a8d99526-05a3-4405-babb-b025479b1b98) to prevent them from leaving bubble as fast but I mainly recommend the other 3 purples mentioned above unless its really hard to pin down targets.
